verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents event types, schedules that set when event types are available, and slot queries. Nothing in it mentions before or after buffers, minimum booking notice, daily booking caps, or date-range booking windows. Availability schedules are a related feature, not the protective controls this story asks for, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can protect my calendar with buffers before and after meetings, minimum notice, daily booking caps, and date-range windows
